name: gitvault
description: Desktop and CLI secrets manager that stores encrypted vaults in your own private GitHub repository.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.bundle: node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.gen:types: cargo test -p gitvault-core export_bindings -q && node scripts/gen-types-index.mjs
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm check:rust && pnpm test:node
